newsitem.title: USA: Continued high pressure for Brazil coffee belt - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Continued high pressure for Brazil coffee belt - WSC.

text.p: Warm, high pressure aloft over Brazil's coffee belt appears strong enough to block cooler air currently in Argentina from entering the region, Weather Services Corp said in an update on Monday.

Dry conditions were observed in main growing areas of the belt this morning. Temperatures warmed to above normal levels for this time of year. Low temperatures were in the 50's to low 60's F (low to middle teens C).

Partly to mostly cloudy skies with episodes of scattered showers are expected through Wednesday. Low temperatures should remain in the 50's to low 60's F (low to middle teens C) in Sao Paulo and Minas Gerais. Low temperatures could possibly fall to 45-50 F (7-10 C) in Northern Parana on Wednesday morning.

The extended outlook calls for continued cloudy skies through the weekend. Low temperatures should be mostly in the 50's F (low to middle teens C). Some cooler conditions are possible in higher elevations, although there is still no damaging cold expected, according to WSC.
